description: Agent-based, network-embedded simulation of mask-wearing adoption with social influence, media information, policy interventions, and market access dynamics operating over daily timesteps.

parameters.health_risk_level: High with probability health_risk_high_fraction else Low
parameters.wears_mask: If has_mask then Bernoulli(initial_adoption_rate) else false

parameters.hours_open_rule: Uniform(8,12) for workplaces/schools, Uniform(10,16) for retail, Uniform(16,20) for transit

parameters.targeting_rules: Bias toward group_identity segments proportional to reach

modules.name: NetworkBuilder
modules.description: Constructs the person-to-person social network (Watts–Strogatz small-world by default).

notes: Run once at initialization. Stores neighbors for each Person as network_neighbors.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if t == 0:
  for person in persons:
    income = max(Normal(income_mean, income_std), 1000)
    trust = clip(Normal(trust_in_authorities_mean, trust_in_authorities_std), 0, 1)
    health_risk = 'high' with prob health_risk_high_fraction else 'low'
    risk0 = Beta(2,2)
    risk_perception = risk0 * (1.2 if health_risk=='high' else 0.8)
    threshold = clip(Normal(threshold_base_mean, threshold_base_std), 0, 1)
    group_identity = Bernoulli(0.5)
    has_mask = Bernoulli(initial_has_mask_rate)
    wears_mask = has_mask and Bernoulli(initial_adoption_rate)
    habit_strength = 0.0
    fatigue_level = 0.0
    compliance_propensity = Uniform(0.3,0.7)
    last_penalized_day = -999
    last_denied_entry_day = -999
    assign network_neighbors from adjacency_list
notes: Per-agent initialization uses provided priors and clips to valid ranges.

modules.name: LocationScheduler
modules.description: Creates locations by type and prepares visit rate profiles.

notes: Location enforcement_level is a base multiplier later combined with authority enforcement_strength.

modules.name: RetailerOperations
modules.description: Initializes retailers and handles daily restocking.

notes: Restock is a simple mean-reverting process; adjust if supply chain data is available.

modules.name: MediaDiffusionEngine
modules.description: Broadcasts media messages and updates agent risk perception and trust.

notes: Authority campaign signal is added to media message valence; misinformation dampens helpful messages and amplifies harmful ones.

modules.name: SocialInfluenceUpdate
modules.description: Updates perceived norms and risk via neighbor observations and adjusts compliance propensity.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for person in persons:
  neigh = person.network_neighbors
  if len(neigh)>0:
    neighbor_mask_rate = mean(neighbor.wears_mask for neighbor in neigh)
  else:
    neighbor_mask_rate = 0
  observed_neighbor_mask_rate[person] = neighbor_mask_rate
  conformity_gap = neighbor_mask_rate - person.social_influence_threshold
  identity_factor = (1 + group_identity_polarization if majority(neigh).group_identity == person.group_identity else 1 - group_identity_polarization)
  delta_risk = social_influence_weight * conformity_gap * 0.5 * identity_factor + 0.2 * locations.norm_signal.get(person.last_location_type, 0)
  delta_comp = social_influence_weight * conformity_gap * 0.3 * identity_factor
  social.delta_risk_perception[person] = delta_risk - risk_decay_rate * (person.risk_perception - 0.5)
  social.delta_compliance_propensity[person] = delta_comp
notes: Implements a Granovetter-style threshold effect with group identity modulation. Risk decays toward 0.5 in absence of signals.

modules.name: PolicyAuthorityEngine
modules.description: Manages mandate timing, enforcement strength, and campaign messaging.

notes: Simple rule-based controller; can be replaced by data-driven policy sequences if available.

modules.name: LocationVisitAndNorms
modules.description: Generates daily visit events and updates location norm signals based on observed compliance.

notes: Norm signals are exponential moving averages by location type; visits can be extended to multiple locations per person per day.

modules.name: MaskAcquisitionEngine
modules.description: Handles individuals purchasing masks from retailers.

update_rule.pseudocode:
purchases = []; unmet = 0
for person in persons:
  need = (not person.has_mask)
  expected_use = 0.5 + 0.5*authority.policy_state.status  # more need under mandate
  affordability = 1 / (1 + price_elasticity * (retailers.avg_price / max(person.income, 1)))
  purchase_prob = clip(expected_use * affordability, 0, 1)
  if need and Bernoulli(purchase_prob):
    r = choose_retailer_by_accessibility()
    if r.inventory_level > 0:
      r.inventory_level -= 1
      person.has_mask = true
      purchases.append((person.id, r.id))
    else:
      unmet += 1
mask_access.unmet_requests = unmet
notes: If no inventory, request is unmet and tracked for shortages metric.

modules.name: PolicyEnforcementEngine
modules.description: Applies mask policy enforcement at locations and records violations.

update_rule.pseudocode:
violations = 0; forced_flags = set()
for (pid, lid, ltype) in visits:
  p = persons[pid]; loc = locations[lid]
  if authority.policy_state.status and ltype in authority.policy_state.scope:  # scope matching by type
    eff_enforce = authority.policy_state.enforcement_strength * loc.enforcement_level
    if not p.wears_mask and Bernoulli(eff_enforce):
      violations += 1
      if Bernoulli(0.5):  # fine vs denial
        p.last_penalized_day = t
        p.compliance_propensity += enforcement_deterrence_alpha * 0.1
        # allow to continue visit
      else:
        p.last_denied_entry_day = t
        # denial may force immediate compliance next time
        forced_flags.add(pid)
        p.compliance_propensity += denial_entry_effect * 0.05
      p.compliance_propensity = clip(p.compliance_propensity, 0, 1)
enforcement.violations = violations
enforcement.forced_compliance_flags = forced_flags
notes: Scope check should map 'indoor_public' to all defined indoor types; here we assume all types are indoor for simplicity unless extended.

modules.name: DecisionAndHabitUpdate
modules.description: Computes daily mask-wearing decisions and updates habit and fatigue.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for person in persons:
  person.risk_perception = clip(person.risk_perception + social.delta_risk_perception[person] + media.delta_risk_perception[person], 0, 1)
  person.trust_in_authorities = clip(person.trust_in_authorities + media.delta_trust[person], 0, 1)
  person.compliance_propensity = clip(person.compliance_propensity + social.delta_compliance_propensity[person], 0, 1)
  policy_pressure = policy_effect_weight * authority.policy_state.status * (0.5 + 0.5*person.trust_in_authorities)
  social_pressure = SocialInfluenceUpdate.observed_neighbor_mask_rate[person] - person.social_influence_threshold
  utility = risk_perception_weight * person.risk_perception + policy_pressure + 0.5*social_pressure + person.habit_strength - mask_use_disutility * (1 - person.habit_strength) - person.fatigue_level
  prob_wear = sigmoid(utility / max(1e-6, wear_decision_temperature))
  if person.id in enforcement.forced_compliance_flags:
    wear = True
  else:
    wear = (person.has_mask and Bernoulli(prob_wear))
  # Update habit and fatigue
  if wear:
    person.habit_strength = clip(person.habit_strength + habit_formation_rate*(1 - person.habit_strength), 0, 1)
    person.fatigue_level = clip(person.fatigue_level + fatigue_rate, 0, 1)
  else:
    person.habit_strength = clip(person.habit_strength - habit_decay_rate*person.habit_strength, 0, 1)
    person.fatigue_level = clip(person.fatigue_level - fatigue_recovery_rate, 0, 1)
  person.wears_mask = wear
notes: Sigmoid converts utility to probability; enforcement can override decision. Habit forms when wearing and decays otherwise; fatigue increases with wearing and recovers otherwise.

modules.name: AdoptionAggregator
modules.description: Computes daily observables and accumulates metrics inputs.

update_rule.pseudocode:
adoption = mean(p.wears_mask for p in persons)
by_type = {}
for loc_type in ['workplaces','schools','retail','transit']:
  vis = [(p,l,t) for (p,l,t) in visits if t==loc_type]
  by_type[loc_type] = mean(persons[p].wears_mask for (p,l,t) in vis) if len(vis)>0 else 0
violations = enforcement.violations
# Voluntary share approximation: fraction of wearers not under active enforcement events
voluntary = mean(p.wears_mask and (p.last_denied_entry_day != t) and (p.last_penalized_day != t) for p in persons)
voluntary_share = voluntary / max(adoption, 1e-6)
unmet_fraction = mask_access.unmet_requests / max(1, population_size)
stockout_fraction = mean(1 if r.stockout_flag else 0 for r in retailers)
write time series outputs
metrics.adoption_rate_latest = adoption
notes: Voluntary share uses a per-day proxy; if detailed flags per-wear event are tracked, use them instead.

initialization.network: Watts-Strogatz small-world with avg_degree and network_rewire_prob

algorithms.watts_strogatz_graph: Generates small-world network with given k and beta.
algorithms.threshold_social_influence: Granovetter-style threshold comparing observed neighbor mask rate to personal threshold to adjust risk/compliance.
algorithms.logistic_choice: Sigmoid of utility determines probability to wear mask.
algorithms.habit_fatigue_dynamics: EMA-style updates for habit formation and fatigue accumulation/recovery.
algorithms.policy_enforcement_rule: Probabilistic enforcement at locations with fines or denial of entry affecting future compliance.
algorithms.inventory_restock: Daily restock stochastic process per retailer.
algorithms.media_signal_processing: Weighted aggregation of channel messages with credibility and misinformation modifiers.
